$comment: The plan file (<name>.plan.json) written by tools/export_plan.py and opened by the electrical editor (Open plan, or paste). JSON Schema keywords: the subset vpt/el_layout.py validate() and the page both implement. One home for the format: vpt/plan.py builds and checks it, the page validates an opened file against this schema embedded in it, the Documentation lists its fields from it.
title: Plan file for the electrical editor (<name>.plan.json)

schema.description: Always vpt_plan: says what kind of file this is.

schema_version.description: Version of this format: 2 adds the windows of every storey (required in version 2, absent in version 1: an older file still opens, its windows are then unknown).

drawing.description: The drawing the plan was exported from. Only its file name and checksum: no folder, no content beyond what the editor draws.

file.description: File name of the DXF (no folder).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the DXF file: the drawing's identity; every layout file records it.

mm_per_unit.description: Millimetres per drawing unit ($INSUNITS); null when unknown.

units_per_m.description: Drawing units per metre (1000 / mm_per_unit); null when unknown.

synthetic.description: True for the toolkit's synthetic sample flat (the page then says so), false for a real drawing.

extract.description: The result of reading rooms, doors and walls (vpt/plan_extract.py): PASS, FAIL or INDETERMINATE, with the reasons.

parameters.description: The parameter file the suggestions and examples were computed with (presets/el_parameters.json).

example_rule.description: Which storey and room the examples use, and the rule that chose them (or why there is none).

svg.description: The storey drawn as SVG (vpt/dxf_svg.py): one <g data-layer> group per DXF layer, a prefixed <style>, no raster images.

layers.description: The storey's drawing layers, as in the layer panel.

affine.description: Model (drawing units) -> SVG viewBox: X = a*x + c*y + e, Y = b*x + d*y + f.

page_mm.description: Page size in mm at scale_1_to (symbols are sized in mm on this page).

windows.description: The window openings (version 2): socket and kitchen suggestions keep clear of them.

checks.description: R1-R6 for this storey (R1-R5 in version 1).

suggest.description: Placement suggestions per rule set (vpt/el_rules.py), in model coordinates.

examples.description: The generated example layouts (simple, complex) when this storey is the example storey, else null.

status.description: Bestand (no status in the name), Abbruch or Neubau.

default_on.description: Shown when the plan opens (false for layers off or frozen in the DXF).

outline.description: The room outline in model coordinates, or null (could not tell).

p.description: One end of the opening, in the middle of the wall (model coordinates).

width_m.description: Width of the opening in metres.

depth_m.description: Depth of the window's lines across the wall in metres.

wall_ids.description: The wall pieces that end at the opening.

rooms.description: The rooms on its two sides (one: an outer wall; none: could not tell).
